name: Wardrobe
description: Save your worn outfits and switch between them instantly by hotkey or menu, with a live 3D preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Switch outfits in the world — the game confirms the change with its own banner.
The Wardrobe window — saved outfits with a live 3D preview of the hovered one.

fixed: Your saved outfits are now kept separately for each character. Switching character — or account — no longer shows another character's wardrobe; each character keeps its own outfits. Your existing outfits stay with the character you are playing when you first update.
